description: Price of an AMERICAN put or call (exercisable on any day up to expiry) on a Cox-Ross-Rubinstein binomial tree with early exercise checked at every node, with a continuous dividend yield. Use it for stock and ETF style options; crypto options on Deribit and Binance are European (`workflow.run_black_scholes`). Output: americanPrice, delta, gamma, thetaPerDay (calendar day, read from the tree, typically 0 when exercising now is optimal), intrinsicValue, earlyExerciseNow (a tree reading: exercising now beats holding), europeanPrice (Black-Scholes, same inputs), earlyExercisePremium, europeanTreePrice and treeError (what the chosen step count costs: the same tree without early exercise minus the exact European price). More steps are closer to the exact value, not smoothly. Rates 0 to 100 percent, dividend yield is a continuous yield, not dated dividends; steps are a whole number from 50 to 2000 (default 500). Prices are USD per unit of underlying.

dividendYieldPct.description: Continuous dividend yield in percent per year, 0 to 100. Default 0.

riskFreeRatePct.description: Annual risk-free rate in percent, 0 to 100. Default 0.

steps.description: Binomial tree steps, whole number from 50 to 2000. Default 500.

strike.description: Strike price, same units as spot

volatilityPct.description: Annualized volatility in percentage points (e.g. 30 for 30%), at most 300

name: workflow.run_american_option
title: American Option
